dialogue.longyou.about.line1: §6§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rOur Corpse Clan is the new ruler of this world, destined to replace fragile humanity.
dialogue.longyou.about.line2: §6§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rThrough continuous evolution, we will become stronger and invincible.
dialogue.longyou.about.line3: §6§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rThe future of the Corpse Clan lies in the hands of you, my subordinates.
dialogue.longyou.appointment.line1: §6§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rAs my subordinate, you have shown extraordinary potential.
dialogue.longyou.appointment.line2: §6§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rI appoint you as an elite warrior of the Corpse Clan and grant you special abilities.
dialogue.longyou.appointment.line3: §6§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rMake good use of this power and fight for the rise of the Corpse Clan!
dialogue.longyou.command.line1: §6§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rMy subordinate, go and gather more life force to strengthen our Corpse Clan.
dialogue.longyou.command.line2: §6§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rEliminate those who resist us and convert them into our kind.
dialogue.longyou.command.line3: §6§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rWhen you become strong enough, I will grant you even greater power.
dialogue.longyou.greeting: [Corpse King·Long You] You have arrived, my subordinate.
dialogue.longyou.mission.already_has: §c§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rYou already have an unfinished mission! Complete it first!
dialogue.longyou.mission.collect_item: §6§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rGo collect %d items! I am very interested in the curiosities of this world!
dialogue.longyou.mission.completed: §a§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rWell done! You have completed the mission, here is your reward!
dialogue.longyou.mission.infect_player: §6§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rGo infect %d players! Make them part of our Corpse Clan! This is the most valuable mission!
dialogue.longyou.mission.kill_any: §6§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rGo kill %d creatures and show your strength!
dialogue.longyou.mission.kill_villager: §6§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rGo slaughter %d villagers and let them know the power of the Corpse Clan!
dialogue.longyou.mission.kill_zombie: §6§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rGo eliminate %d zombies or Zombie Brothers and cleanse those inferior kind!
dialogue.longyou.mission.no_completed: §c§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rYou have no completed missions! Complete one before coming back to me!
dialogue.longyou.mission.received: §a§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rHere is your mission scroll. Bring it back to me once completed. Mission: %s
dialogue.longyou.only_corpse: §4§lOnly Zombie Brothers can speak with the Corpse King!
dialogue.longyou.option.command: What are your orders, my lord?
dialogue.longyou.rebellion: §4§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rYou dare to attack me? This is treason!
dialogue.longyou.rebellion.broadcast: §4§l[Corpse King·Long You] §r%s dared to attack me! This is treason!
dialogue.longyou.task.line1: §6§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rI have unlocked the mission system for you. Complete missions to gain Evolution Points and special rewards.
dialogue.longyou.task.line2: §6§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rMissions include: eliminating humans, infecting villagers, collecting resources, and more.
dialogue.longyou.task.line3: §6§l[Corpse King·Long You] §rThe more missions you complete, the higher your level, and the greater your rewards.
